name: Lard Lost His Lunch
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.
narrative.objectives:
Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.

Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Lard takes the huge haunch of meat from you and stuffs it in his face.>

Dis hit da spot! Tanks little one.

Lard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.
narrative.requestItemsText:
<Lard rubs his enormous belly.>

Lard so hungry.
